## Episode Thesis

The guest is Lars Thylander, chairman of the Danish property investor Thylander Gruppen. He talks about the more than DKK 2bn redevelopment of Danske Bank's former headquarters on Laksegade into a Four Seasons-anchored district, and his firm's two main strategies: rental housing in Greater Copenhagen, where he sees an undersupply of homes, and hyperscale data centres in Esbjerg. Personally he avoids single stocks and holds ETFs (Vanguard, iShares), venture and private equity. He is wary of interest rates for property valuations and refuses bank debt. No buy or sell views on listed equities were given.
